name: Add Activity Tracking Endpoint
description: Add a POST /api/users/:id/activity endpoint that logs an activity entry for a user. Each activity has: { action: string, timestamp: string, details?: object }. Store in-memory. Return the created activity with 201. Must validate that action is non-empty string.

name: Add Pagination to GET /api/users
description: Add pagination support to the GET /api/users endpoint. Accept ?page=1&limit=10 query params. Return { data: [...], total: number, page: number, limit: number, totalPages: number }. Default page=1, limit=10. max limit=100.
successCriteria: GET /api/users?page=1&limit=2 returns 2 users with pagination metadata

name: Add Rate Limiting Middleware
description: Add rate limiting middleware that limits requests to /api/* to 100 requests per minute per IP. Store counters in-memory. Return 429 with { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', retryAfter: number } when exceeded. Exclude /health endpoint. Make the limit configurable via RATE_LIMIT_MAX env var (default 100).
successCriteria: Rate limit middleware is applied to /api/* routes

name: Refactor users routes to a service layer
description: Refactor the user store + lookup out of the route into a dedicated service layer: create src/services/userService.js exposing listUsers() and getUserById(id), and make src/routes/users.js delegate to it. Do NOT change API behavior — the response shape and status codes must stay identical and all existing tests must stay green.
successCriteria: src/routes/users.js delegates to the service (no duplicated inline store)
GET /api/users returns the same data as before
GET /api/users/:id returns the same data as before

name: Fix auth bypass + input validation (multi-layer bug)
description: Two security bugs exist: (1) the auth middleware only checks token truthiness, so the literal strings 'null' or 'undefined' in the Authorization header bypass authentication; (2) non-numeric :id in GET /api/users/:id returns 404 instead of 400. Fix both: reject 'null'/'undefined' auth headers (still allow real Bearer tokens, /health stays public), and return 400 for non-numeric ids. All existing tests must stay green.
